title: Crank pin in a pivoted slot
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of B (spin) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. The top crank pin sweeps right under CW drive. The slot takes the transverse component above the rocker pivot. A positive, B positive. The requested motion is CW (in listed output order).
